semantic.justification: Source conversion flags and ported single-byte descriptors are used by Calc CSV; the full converter registry and stream contracts remain pending. Native UTF-8 OStringToOUString now consumes the existing pinned SAL converter with the source final FLUSH flag instead of host TextDecoder. Preserves native grouping of broken, overlong, surrogate and five-byte sequences, BOM retention and output-length bounds. Seven new malformed/signature cases plus actual Markdown callback admission cover this path. Other pre-existing string conversion branches, including UTF-8 encoding, remain independently unverified.
